name: First Aid Kit Checklist
description: A checklist of supplies to stock in a home and car first aid kit, organized by category.

items.text: A small flashlight with spare batteries

items.note: Keep all medicines in date and suitable for your household

items.text: A reflective vest or warning triangle
A phone charger or power bank
A first aid instruction card or booklet
Notes on any family allergies or conditions
Check expiry dates and replace expired items
Restock anything used and review twice a year
items.note: For emergencies, call your local emergency number such as 911

items.text: This checklist is general information only and is not medical advice; a first aid kit does not replace professional care, so for serious injuries or emergencies call your local emergency number and follow guidance from trained responders
items.note: Consider a recognized first aid training course

faq.q: What should every first aid kit include?
faq.a: Most kits include adhesive bandages, gauze, tape, antiseptic, gloves, scissors, tweezers, and basic medicines. Add items for your family's needs, and keep an emergency contact and instruction card inside.

faq.q: Do I need a separate kit for my car?
faq.a: A car kit is helpful for travel and roadside situations. It can mirror your home kit with added items like a blanket and flashlight. Keep it where it stays out of extreme heat when possible.

faq.q: How often should I check my first aid kit?
faq.a: Review your kits at least twice a year. Replace anything used, expired, or damaged, and update supplies as your family's needs change so the kit stays ready.

faq.q: Should I include medicines in a first aid kit?
faq.a: Basic items like pain relief can be useful, but keep them in date and suitable for your household. For anyone's prescription medicines, follow their doctor's instructions and store them as directed.

faq.q: Is this first aid kit checklist printable?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or download the PDF, keep a copy inside each kit, and use it to check supplies and restock after any use.
